item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hatsuen Kikan
  • 発売日: 2012-02-12
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 転校生に寄ってたかって集団暴行
  • 英語名: Tenkousei ni Yottetakatte Shuudan Boukou

别名

  • Lynching of the Transfer Student

あらすじ

The transfer student was taken to a secret room.

They beat her. They punched her until her creamy white skin was purple. Her naked body was photographed, and her splayed sensitive genitals jammed with a foreign object. Then two men took their pleasure…

A violent, brutal mobbing of a schoolgirl.
